start: A new online gym, the owner signed in; menu row 'Set up your gym' with a ring

user_sees: Steps in order: 'Add your plans', 'Bring in your members', 'Add your logo and colours', 'Add your staff and trainers', 'Set your gym timings', 'Let people find and join your gym online', 'Print the check-in poster', 'Send members the app link', each with a one-line hint
must_not: A step ticked that the gym has not done
The old count of five steps

steps.action: Tap 'Add your plans' and add one plan
user_sees: The Plans screen, with a slim bar 'Next step: Bring in your members ›' and 'Back to the list'
must_not: The bar on screens that were not opened from the list

user_sees: 'Add your plans' is ticked and the line says '1 of 8 done'; the menu ring is fuller
must_not: The ring and the line showing different counts

steps.action: Tap 'Mark done' beside 'Add your logo and colours'
user_sees: The step is ticked and the count goes up
must_not: 'Mark done' offered on steps the records can prove, such as plans or timings

user_sees: 'All done. Your gym is ready for members.'; the ring leaves the menu row
must_not: The ring staying after all steps are done

start: A setup screen opened from the list (the 'Next step' bar), with steps left

steps.action: On Plans, tap 'Next step: Bring in your members ›'
user_sees: The Members screen with the bar for the step after it
must_not: The bar offering a step that is already done
The bar pointing at the same step

steps.action: Open 'Let people find and join your gym online', then its payments screen
user_sees: On that other screen the bar says 'Back to “Let people find and join your gym online”'
must_not: 'Next step' there, which would skip the rest of the online journey

steps.action: Share the gym's link after choosing 'Not now' for the web page
must_not: The step ticked by 'Not now' alone, before the link was shared

start: Set up your gym, in gyms where a part does not apply

steps.action: Sign in as front-desk staff and look for 'Set up your gym'
user_sees: No such row and no steps
must_not: Setup steps or the ring shown to staff

steps.action: Open the demo gym or a gym that is not online
must_not: A step that can never be finished in this gym

steps.action: Open a gym whose web page MettleUp HQ switched off
user_sees: The step is titled 'Let people join your gym online' with the hint 'Share your join link and QR poster, and see how people pay.'
must_not: Words promising a web page this gym cannot make

steps.action: Open a gym whose page MettleUp took down
user_sees: The step ticks only after the join link is shared
must_not: The step shown done because the page was published before it was taken down

start: Set up your gym, three steps done, five left

steps.action: Tap 'Move this page to the bottom of the menu'
user_sees: 'Show this page at the top of the menu again'; the row is now under 'Your gym' and still shows its ring
must_not: The ring or the count gone from the row

steps.action: Tap 'Show this page at the top of the menu again'
user_sees: 'Move this page to the bottom of the menu' and 'You can still open it from Your gym in the menu.'; the row is back at the top
'Bring in your members' is not ticked any more
must_not: A done count that the records no longer back

steps.action: Tap 'Mark done' by mistake, then look for a way to undo it
user_sees: A way to untick the step
must_not: A hand tick that can never be taken back

steps.action: Open the panel in another browser
user_sees: Steps the records prove are ticked; the hand-ticked ones are not
must_not: A step shown done on one device and the gym told it is 'All done' while another device still shows the ring, with no word why
